subject: GPU staging readiness & scaling play — CinderAI
messages:
From: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>
To: Sasha Bloom <sasha@cinderai.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-03-03T08:15:00-07:00
Subject: GPU staging readiness & scaling play — CinderAI

Sasha —

Thanks for the rapid demo last week. As we discussed, CinderAI's launch plan (Q2 integration + P50 traffic ramp) will need a dedicated staging pool for a 4-week verification window before production cutover. High level ask: can we provision a provisional, non-billing soft hold on dedicated GPUs for two weeks to guarantee availability during the staging window?

Prelim sizing from your engineering doc: peak concurrent inference expected ~350 qps (batched), model loads ~110B parameters (KV cache heavy). Our rough translation is ~16x A100-equivalent GPUs (or ~8x H100) for the staging pool at 4x batch concurrency. We don't need final placement yet — we just want to lock runway so procurement and your launch manager can coordinate.

Please confirm the target dates you want reserved (CinderAI suggested 2027-04-11 to 2027-05-09) and whether you want us to include a short rollback window. If you confirm today, I'll loop in Ops to surface a soft-hold and push the MAP + procurement paperwork.

Attachments: CinderAI MAP (draft) — cinderai_MAP_v1.pdf (attached)

Next steps (proposed):
- Sasha: confirm staging window dates and procurement contact
- Redwood (me): request soft-hold, share hold form with Ops
- Ops (cc): size and map nodes, propose fallback (re-quantized smaller model) if production capacity gets tight

Thanks —
Marcus Lin
Enterprise AE, Redwood Inference
marcus@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0123

From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: Sasha Bloom <sasha@cinderai.com>
Date: 2027-03-03T10:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: GPU staging readiness & scaling play — CinderAI

Marcus / team —

Quick inventory snapshot for the proposed window (2027-04-11 -> 2027-05-09):
- Uncommitted H100s (us-west-2 pools): 24 units available across two racks (subject to short-term bursts).
- Uncommitted A100-equivalents (multi-gen mix): ~36 units, but fragmentation may require co-locating 16 units across two host groups.
- Already-allocated Reserved Pools: 128 GPUs in the same timeframe across existing dedicated customers — leaves limited contiguous block sizes.

We can offer a provisional soft hold for up to 16 H100-equivalent GPUs for a 2-week window (we'll tag them as "soft-hold/cinderai/deal-2384"). Soft hold means we will not reassign them for other reserved capacity sales but we do not convert to invoiced committed capacity until we get a signed MAP and PO. If CinderAI prefers a hard reserve (billing/commit), we need procurement paperwork and finance signoff — that typically takes 5–7 business days.

Operational notes:
- We recommend splitting the staging pool into 2 host groups (8+8) to reduce thermal/noise risk and speed rollbacks.
- If CinderAI can accept a 4-bit quantized variant for the high-concurrency smoke tests, we can reduce the footprint by ~35% (i.e., 10–11 H100-equivalents).
- I'll attach the internal soft-hold request form; please populate any missing MAP fields and loop in procurement: procure@cinderai.com

Attachments: soft_hold_request_form.pdf

I'll stand by to convert the soft hold to a committed reservation once we get the signed MAP + PO.

— Neha
Director, Capacity Planning | Redwood Inference
neha_kapoor@redwood.com

From: Sasha Bloom <sasha@cinderai.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>
Cc: procure@cinderai.com, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-03-03T11:46:00-07:00
Subject: Re: GPU staging readiness & scaling play — CinderAI

Thanks Marcus / Neha —

Confirmed: CinderAI would like the provisional soft hold for the staging window 2027-04-11 → 2027-05-09. Procurement contact is procure@cinderai.com (cc'd). We will sign the MAP and return it by EOD 2027-03-04; PO expected by 2027-03-08.

We also accept the two-host-group recommendation. Regarding quantization: engineering prefers to test the non-quantized model in staging for fidelity checks; fallback to quantized variant only if we hit hardware constraints.

Can you confirm whether Redwood will provide a one-week rollback buffer after the staging window? That would help our launch plan.

Best,
Sasha Bloom
Head of Platform — CinderAI
sasha@cinderai.com
+1 (650) 555-2211

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>

Cc: Sasha Bloom <sasha@cinderai.com>
Date: 2027-03-03T17:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: GPU staging readiness & scaling play — CinderAI

Thanks — Neha that snapshot is helpful. Operations asks for two quick clarifications so we can seed the internal ticket and start node tagging:
1) Final expected sustained token throughput for staging smoke tests (tokens/sec) — Sasha's earlier doc had bursts up to 1.2M tokens/minute; we need a sustained estimate.
2) Acceptable pre-empt policy: during staging, would CinderAI allow pre-emption with a 30-minute graceful drain (if a higher-SLA committed customer needs the node)? This affects whether we use preemptible host pools or dedicated reserved nodes.

Assuming Sasha confirms sustained load <= 800k tokens/min and no pre-emption, Ops will create a dedicated soft-hold group (tag + allocation playbook) and map 16 H100-eq capacity with a 7-day rollback buffer post-staging. If pre-emption is acceptable, we can reduce to 12 H100-eq using preemptible farms.

I'll create the Redwood internal ticket and include the resource mapping workbook. Laura — can you start the ticket and attach resource_mapping.xlsx?

— Karthik
Sr. Customer Solutions
karthik_iyer@redwood.com
